justification: Puts flood back in six navigation surfaces and lifts its noindex. Not Critical: no data or answer logic changes. Not Minor: user-facing menus and copy on every page.

falsifiable_check.fails_when: Fails if flood routes are still treated as hidden, or if bushfire, solar or climate links reappear anywhere.
falsifiable_check.external_authority: Owner instruction 2026-10-30 (reply 'y'): bring flood back into the menus; the rest stays withdrawn.
falsifiable_check.observed_red: Before the test edit, isHiddenPath('/reports/flood') expected true and failed once flood was unhidden.

pre_impl.existing_data: lib/hidden-products.ts already lists withdrawn route prefixes; sitemap and middleware read it.
pre_impl.assumption_mismatch: Old flood copy named satellite radar, which the flood answer does not use, so it was rewritten, not restored.
pre_impl.new_vs_existing: No new files; six one-line link entries and one rewritten reports card.
pre_impl.external_source_error: Not applicable: no external source is called.

functions.name: isHiddenPath
functions.what: Matches a withdrawn route or its sub-pages; flood prefixes removed.
functions.input: a path or full URL string
functions.output: true when the path is still withdrawn
functions.if_none: A malformed URL returns false, not an error.
functions.failure_mode: A leftover flood prefix would keep flood out of the sitemap and noindexed

break_it.what_happens: Search engines keep ignoring flood pages
break_it.how: middleware and sitemap both read the same list, which no longer has flood

break_it.scenario: Bushfire links come back by accident
break_it.what_happens: The link gate test fails in CI
break_it.how: repo-wide string scan unchanged for the other products

break_it.scenario: An old blog post still says flood is unavailable
break_it.what_happens: Copy is stale but no link is broken; flood pages work
break_it.how: listed under gaps for a follow-up copy pass

verified: tsc: no errors in changed files
gaps: Blog posts and other pages that linked to flood before #1538 are not re-linked; only the main menus, footer, sitemap, reports hub and site directory are

post_merge.action: After deploy: curl -I /reports/flood shows no X-Robots-Tag noindex; sitemap 2 lists flood council pages
post_merge.manual_verify: Header, footer and reports page show a Flood link; bushfire, solar and climate links stay absent
